scope: Primary repository model products and explicit first-principles kinematics. No biological Sun-following observation or new atmospheric calculation is claimed.

sources.use: Lunar radius, mean synodic period, lunar equator-to-ecliptic inclination, physical photon constants and time units.
sources.method: Latitude-circle circumference divided by synodic period; solar elevation from the dot product of the local zenith and solar direction. Constant-speed mismatch gives angular drift and relative solar period.
sources.limit: Mean rotation/solar motion and fixed latitude. Nonuniform ephemeris, weather trajectories, refraction and terrain are not solved. Declination bounds are a geometric sensitivity.

sources.use: Committed design-column direct and diffuse spectra on1nm bins, ground return and stored PAR summaries at solar heights1–90degrees. Neutral ground albedo0.1 and the product's (direct+diffuse_black)/(1-albedo*reflectance) reading rule.
sources.limit: Ground horizontal flux only,202–1000nm, not bolometric or aerial. The older daylight calculation underestimates low-Sun flux relative to the spherical atlas. Reconstructed binned PAR differs slightly from pre-binning summary precision.

sources.use: Exact near/far-site PAR-darkness, maintenance-deficit, reserve and respiration outputs; stored twilight PAR table and the producer's fixed1degree diffuse-black spectrum approximation.
sources.limit: LAI5 ground stand, zero-declination geometry and land temperature traces. No Earthlight in its light inputs. The historical respiration_in_the_dark field integrates geometric Sun-below-horizon respiration, not PAR-below1 respiration. Twilight spectral shape is assumed, not solved anew.

sources.use: Preserve inherited C3 reference-canopy responses by solar height as context.
sources.limit: LAI5 ground stand with its prescribed temperatures/CO2. Not floater productivity, altitude response, whole-organism compensation or continuous-light validation.

sources.use: Current solved ground point-source solar diffuse illuminance at twilight elevations, kept distinct from the historical plant approximation.
sources.limit: Photopic lux transfer, not ground spectral irradiance. Finite solar disk and Earthlight are not integrated by this study. Ground-only, no local clouds, observer-altitude correction or biological action-spectrum conversion.
